description: Deterministic /rv first frame built by the Swift client (RendezvousFirstFrame.build with token bytes i*7 mod 256, now = nowSeconds, session-tag RNG yielding bytes 0x00..0x0F, default base-36 PoW nonce search). Swift asserts it builds byte-for-byte; the Worker asserts verifyRendezvousClaim/parseSessionId accept it. Independently recomputed in Python when created.
